package planted

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/margince/margince/backend/internal/platform/httperr"
)

const plantedConst = "planted_const"

const plantedConverted = string(plantedConst + "_converted")

type reason string

const (
	reasonFirst  reason = "planted_typed_first"
	reasonSecond reason = "planted_typed_second"
)

func literal() error {
	return &httperr.DetailedError{Status: http.StatusConflict, Code: "planted_literal"}
}

func constant() error { return &httperr.DetailedError{Code: plantedConst} }

func converted() error { return &httperr.DetailedError{Code: plantedConverted} }

func refuse(code string) error { return &httperr.DetailedError{Code: code} }

func passesOn(code string) error { return refuse(code) }

func callers() {
	_ = refuse("planted_param")
	_ = passesOn("planted_passed_on")
}

type handler struct{}

func (handler) deny(code string) error { return &httperr.DetailedError{Code: code} }

func (h handler) callsMethod() error { return h.deny("planted_method") }

type fieldError struct{ code string }

func (e *fieldError) Error() string { return e.code }

func (e *fieldError) MessageFault() (code, message string) { return e.code, "" }

func builds() error { return &fieldError{code: "planted_field"} }

type typedError struct{ Reason reason }

func (e typedError) MessageFault() (string, string) { return string(e.Reason), "" }

type literalFault struct{}

func (literalFault) MessageFault() (code, message string) { return "planted_fault_return", "" }

func assigned(conflict bool) error {
	refusal := &httperr.DetailedError{Status: http.StatusConflict}
	if conflict {
		refusal.Code = "planted_assigned"
	}
	return refusal
}

func ranged(err error) error {
	for _, row := range []struct {
		cause error
		code  string
	}{
		{nil, "planted_ranged"},
	} {
		if err == row.cause {
			return &httperr.DetailedError{Code: row.code}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func elided() []*httperr.DetailedError {
	return []*httperr.DetailedError{{Code: "planted_elided"}}
}

func relayed(err error) error {
	var busy *httperr.DetailedError
	return &httperr.DetailedError{Code: busy.Code}
}

func formatted(n int) error { return &httperr.DetailedError{Code: fmt.Sprintf("planted_%d", n)} }

func lowered(s string) error { return &httperr.DetailedError{Code: strings.ToLower(s)} }

func asValue() func(string) error {
	return valueHelper
}

func valueHelper(code string) error { return &httperr.DetailedError{Code: code} }

func multiValue() (error, error) {
	refusal := &httperr.DetailedError{}
	var err error
	refusal.Code, err = codeAndErr()
	return refusal, err
}

func codeAndErr() (string, error) { return "planted_unread", nil }

type holder struct{ refusal *httperr.DetailedError }

func nested(h holder) { h.refusal.Code = "planted_nested" }

type repeated string

const (
	repeatedFirst repeated = "planted_repeated"
	repeatedSecond
)
